description: FEAT-LISTS Item Manager actions (modListViewExt LV_SetActionCell, LV_CopySelectedActionsToClipboard, LV_DeleteSelected, LV_InvertSelection) over a mutable ListView.
notes: The Item Manager is frmMain.lvItemManager (ListView shim). A row is {Text, Sub, Sel}; the dump after the call has the same shape (sel only when selected). The action cell is sub item 2 (Flag), QTY 3, Source 4, Enc 5 (1-based, as MME).
frmMain.RefreshAll, lvItemManager_ItemClick and SetFocus do nothing here; bPromptSave is read back from the global.
A case's msgbox lists the answers to the boxes MME shows (6 Yes, 7 No); without it the default button answers (Yes for the encumbrance question, No for the delete confirmation).
data holds the stock Items rows the cases name (name, ItemType, Encum) for the Rust test. Generated by tools/oracle/gen/item_manager.py.
